hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook gen3
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Pons gen3 meme launch pools. Takes a fee on top of each swap (hook fee plus per-pool creator tax, frozen at registration and capped at 20% in total) via delta return, and applies an anti-snipe buy tax (up to 99%, decaying to zero within 3 seconds) that the factory can arm only once per pool, at launch. Pool initialization is restricted to the factory.
